about.title: Hi
about.intro: I'm <name>Hernando Rey</name>, an electronics engineer and full stack developer.
about.lead: I combine hardware and software to solve concrete problems for businesses and at home.
about.body: I trained at the Henry bootcamp and keep learning on my own. I work mostly with React and Firebase, using Cloud Functions for server-side logic, and with ESP32, ESPHome and Home Assistant for the physical side. I enjoy the whole process: talking to the people who will use the app, building it, shipping it, and improving it once it's in use.

items: Ferrequipos De La Costa: online store, kiosk mode, quotes, billing statements and accounts receivable; Cloud Functions and tests with Vitest.
VoxDei: church projection system with a control panel and role-based user permissions.
Alarma ITX: 8 ESP32 sensors with custom firmware, real-time charts and Telegram alerts.
